ui.title: Equestria OS Task Panel Styles
ui.subtitle: Select a layout preset
ui.restore_all_msg: This will restore all presets to system defaults and remove any custom presets. Continue?
ui.delete_confirm_msg: Are you sure you want to delete this preset?
ui.err_capture: Could not capture the layout: Plasma is not responding.
ui.err_plasma: Plasma could not apply the preset: {0}
help.ed_color: The panel has a day color and a night color. KDE switches them together with the day/night global theme of your character. Text on the panel always follows the color scheme.
help.ed_hide_icons: Shows or hides desktop icons while this preset is active. Changing it restarts the Plasma shell for a few seconds.
help.ed_kde: Unlocks KDE panels so you can move, resize and add widgets right on them. Then press "Capture current panels" below to save the result into this preset.
help.ed_layout: Saves the panels you arranged in KDE into this preset; selecting the preset later restores them. Wallpaper and desktop are not affected.
